Thanks Marco — welcome. Quick answers below and next steps.

- Invoice delivery: Primary route is AP inbox (ap-payments@redwood.com) or our vendor portal (we'll enable your company account once onboarding is completed). For recurring integrations we prefer emailed invoices with a PO reference.
- PO creation: Procurement (Karthik) will provision a PO number once the onboarding form is processed and the SOW is approved. We require the PO number on the invoice line for automated routing.
- Terms & early pay: Standard is Net 45 for new vendors, but we can do Net 30 by exception. We also offer an early-pay program (Net 15) for a small discount — typical program rates are 1.25%–2.0% depending on volume. Marissa will confirm eligibility.

Next steps:
1) Marco, please fill the attached onboarding workbook (I'll reattach an editable copy) and return with a copy of your bank remittance advice.
2) Karthik/procurement: once we have the completed form + SOW, please create the PO and confirm routing rules.
3) Marissa/finance: please advise whether NimbleStats qualifies for the early-pay tier and the applicable discount.

I'll leave this thread open and can expedite the portal activation once I have the completed onboarding file.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

Hi all — looping in finance details.

Marco, welcome. A few notes from AP: 
- Send invoices to ap-payments@redwood.com with the PO number in the invoice header and line items. We will also accept uploads via the vendor portal once activated.
- Standard payment window for first 90 days is Net 45 while we complete supplier validation. After that, we can move to Net 30 subject to a clean record.
- Early-pay enrollment: we run a weekly early-pay cycle (cutoff Friday 12:00pm PT). If you want Net 15 early-pay, we can offer 2.0% discount for the first 90 days; thereafter discount tiers depend on annual invoiced volume. Please review the attached EarlyPay_Terms.pdf.

Karthik — when you receive the completed onboarding workbook, please validate the tax docs and set up the PO provisioning flow so invoices are matched automatically in Coupa.

Marissa Cole
